facts.line: 山陽線・広島西条区間
facts.locator: Bounded static composite: current central Hiroshima University access explicitly recommends a local train Hiroshima to Saijo. Its own RISE native table explicitly marks Hiroshima city <–> Higashi Hiroshima city and identifies JR local train Hiroshima Station–Saijo Station, supporting each direction rather than mechanically reversing. JNTO separately defines local as all-station and rapid as distinct; JR cnh current map provides exact G01–G10 order only. RISE has undated stale Green Phoenix bus content, explicitly contradicted by updated central guidance; that bus content and all clocks/fares are excluded. Current railway existence is corroborated by central guide, but no particular train, October service day or frequency is claimed. Ten original components/restrictions remain unchanged. No restricted timetable processing.
